blockers.finding: compiler_build sends SIGTERM on timeout, then calls communicate(timeout=5); second timeout is uncaught and no SIGKILL/communicate drain follows
blockers.impact: A compiler descendant retaining its pipe can escape bounded cleanup; no final compiler receipt or status is produced
blockers.requiredSourceChange: Reuse run-style SIGTERM, bounded wait, SIGKILL, and final drain for compiler process group before any actual capture

blockers.impact: Resolver can block before compiler receipt creation, defeating bounded subprocess admission
